content: Design-token best practice is a primitive -> semantic -> (optional) component token hierarchy: raw values (--blue-500) stay separate from semantic/purpose tokens (--color-primary, --color-surface) that components consume; themes are implemented purely by remapping semantic tokens per selector/attribute (e.g. [data-theme=x]), never by giving themes their own component markup or CSS overrides outside the token layer. This is exactly the 'tokens + enumerated variants, never free composition' line Mercora has already chosen. DTCG-format token files + Style Dictionary are the emerging interchange standard for generating platform-specific output, but a hand-maintained CSS custom-property contract is sufficient at Mercora's scale (~18 tokens).
